html:
Greenland is the world's largest island, between the Arctic and Atlantic oceans, and a self-governing part of the Kingdom of Denmark. Most of its people are Kalaallit, Inuit whose ancestors came from Alaska with the Thule culture around 1200.

Norse settlers led by Erik the Red farmed its southwest coast from about 985, but their colonies died out in the 1400s. In 1721 the Norwegian missionary Hans Egede arrived, and Denmark-Norway made the island a colony with a royal trade monopoly. It stayed with Denmark when Norway was split off in 1814.

In the Second World War the United States built bases there, and the air base at Thule, now Pituffik Space Base, became a key site of the Cold War. Greenland stopped being a colony in 1953, won home rule in 1979, left the European Economic Community in 1985 over fishing rights, and gained wider self-rule in 2009. Its capital is Nuuk.
